title: 25 Years for the CEO, 5 for the CFO: The WorldCom Sentences

lines.say: WorldCom's finance chief, Scott Sullivan, directed the accounting entries. Judge Barbara Jones called him the architect of the fraud.
lines.show: WorldCom's finance chief, Scott Sullivan, directed the accounting entries. Judge Barbara Jones called him "the architect of the fraud."

lines.say: He pleaded guilty and testified against his boss. He got five years. The controller, a year and a day.
CEO Bernard Ebbers went to trial. The judge credited testimony that he was the instigator.

scene.src: Gov't letter, S.D.N.Y., Oct 4, 2019 · Sentencing transcript, Jul 13, 2005

lines.say: His guidelines range: thirty years to life. She gave him twenty-five.
The appeals court said the difference was cooperation, and rank. Each of the others was his subordinate.
Its verdict on twenty-five years: harsh but not unreasonable.
lines.show: Its verdict on 25 years: "harsh but not unreasonable."

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
